data.name: 疾擎速骋Rapid Engine Speed
data.detailed_description:
A poor teenage boy dreams of becoming a professional motorcycle racer. After repeated rejections, he chances upon an HR from a racing club. The HR brushes him off reluctantly and gives him a trial tryout just to dampen his spirit, only to unexpectedly discover the boy’s extraordinary natural talent for motorcycle riding—marking the start of his road to redemption and greatness.

Starting as a rookie trainee, he relies on his innate gift to compete in tournaments at all levels, overcome doubts from others, grow into a top professional racer, claim the championship of the premier league, and fulfill his racing dream.

• Controls: Realistic motorcycle handling, focusing on gear shifting, drifting and corner balance skills.
• Progression: Upgrade and customize your motorcycle; improve the racer’s abilities including reflexes, handling and stamina.
• Tournaments: Compete and advance step by step from amateur races to professional leagues.

Extra Game Modes
• Career Mode: Main storyline of chasing the racing dream.
• Free Practice Mode: Get familiar with tracks and refine your riding skills.
• Time Challenge Mode: Earn rare customization parts.

data.short_description: 《Rapid Engine Speed》 is a realistic motorcycle racing game focused on authentic handling. Ditch the convenience of automatic shifting, and experience the full manual gear-shifting process from pulling the clutch and shifting gears to throttle control.
